posts.title: Before Data Centers Tear Down Another Home, Listen to Ansley Brown
posts.description: Ansley Brown’s family donated usable fixtures from their condemned Georgia home, inspiring calls for Georgia Power and data-center developers to redistribute materials from demolished properties to communities in need.

posts.title: Google’s Moat Continues to Drain: The AI Arms Race and the Art of Not Spending
posts.description: AI threatens Google’s search dominance by replacing a highly profitable moat with costly, uncertain competition. The decisive advantage may come not from building more infrastructure, but from developing radically efficient computing that reduces AI’s capital, energy, and political burdens.

posts.title: 2027 Mechanical Royalty Rate Rises to 13.6 Cents: Inflation Protection Works
posts.description: The 2027 statutory mechanical royalty rate will rise to 13.6 cents per song, or 2.62 cents per minute, reflecting CPI inflation. The adjustment underscores the transparency and importance of preserving penny rates and COLAs.
